Method of Attack: Collecting SMS messages, call history, address books, app lists, phone hardware identifiers
Installing new apps or updating existing ones without user knowledge or consent
Impacted Systems: Over 700 million devices including low-budget Android phones
Some Android Barnes & Noble NOOK tablets
Phones bought from legitimate phone carriers in countries such as the UK
Attack Vector: Backdoor hidden inside built-in and unremovable app responsible for firmware-over-the-air update (FOTA)
Unremovable app component with ability to install/update apps without user consent
